description: Ecossistema de aprendizado inteligente, adaptativo e organizado do ensino fundamental ao vestibular/universitário

Always use modern button styles with hover and focus states.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements.
Implement gorgeous adaptive layouts with generous spacing and Bento grids.
